mapper.select: SELECT ddpags.id, 0 user_type, dugroq.dates, dugroq.pkg, dugroq.version, dugroq.game_code, dugroq.user_num, dugroq.play_game_num, dugroq.play_game_total_time, dugroq.total_expend, dugroq.total_reward FROM (SELECT dugro.dates, dugro.pkg, dugro.version, dugro.game_code, COUNT(DISTINCT dugro.user_id) user_num, COUNT(1) play_game_num, IFNULL(SUM(dugro.played_time), 0) play_game_total_time, IFNULL(SUM(dugro.expend), 0) total_expend, IFNULL(SUM(dugro.reward), 0) total_reward from dwd_user_game_record_oeta dugro WHERE dugro.dates = #{dates} GROUP BY dugro.dates, dugro.pkg, dugro.version, dugro.game_code) dugroq LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_all_game_single ddpags on (ddpags.dates = dugroq.dates and ddpags.pkg = dugroq.pkg and ddpags.version = dugroq.version and ddpags.game_code = dugroq.game_code and ddpags.user_type = 0)

SELECT ddpags.id, 1 user_type, dugroq.dates, dugroq.pkg, dugroq.version, dugroq.game_code, dugroq.user_num, dugroq.play_game_num, dugroq.play_game_total_time, dugroq.total_expend, dugroq.total_reward FROM (SELECT dugro.dates, dugro.pkg, dugro.version, dugro.game_code, COUNT(DISTINCT dugro.user_id) user_num, COUNT(1) play_game_num, IFNULL(SUM(dugro.played_time), 0) play_game_total_time, IFNULL(SUM(dugro.expend), 0) total_expend, IFNULL(SUM(dugro.reward), 0) total_reward from dwd_user_game_record_oeta dugro INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui on (dui.user_id = dugro.user_id and dui.dates = dugro.dates) WHERE dugro.dates = #{dates} GROUP BY dugro.dates, dugro.pkg, dugro.version, dugro.game_code) dugroq LEFT JOIN dws_daily_package_all_game_single ddpags on (ddpags.dates = dugroq.dates and ddpags.pkg = dugroq.pkg and ddpags.version = dugroq.version and ddpags.game_code = dugroq.game_code and ddpags.user_type = 1)

SELECT id, dates, pkg, version, user_type, game_code, user_num, play_game_num, play_game_total_time, avg_user_play_game_num, avg_user_play_time, total_expend, avg_user_expend, total_reward, avg_user_reward, rtp, create_time FROM dws_daily_package_all_game_single WHERE dates = #{dates}
